name: barretos-clash
description: Barretos Clash: A Lenda do Laço — versão web e mobile

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build:web && cap add ios
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:config && node scripts/verify-web.mjs
scripts.check:js: node --check js/ai.js && node --check js/audio.js && node --check js/characters.js && node --check js/combat.js && node --check js/game.js && node --check js/input.js && node --check js/main.js && node --check js/player.js && node --check js/sprites.js
scripts.check:config: node --check scripts/build-web.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-config.mjs
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
